# Brex — account brief

## Who
Brex offers corporate cards and spend management software for startups and enterprises ([brex.com](https://brex.com/)). Its GitHub org is brexhq, linked to brex.com ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is present in brexhq/brex-mobile ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native 0.74.5 in brex-mobile's package.json ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows in brex-mobile ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- brex-mobile last pushed 2026-08-15 ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile))
- 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141))
- 28,000 App Store ratings ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141))
- Open issue: "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87))
- GitHub org description names a regulated category ("financial") ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq))

## Why now
The app shipped 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). The repo was last pushed on 2026-08-15 ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile)), and there is an open issue about an Expo SDK 52 upgrade blocked by a native module mismatch ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Suggested opener
I saw brex-mobile builds with EAS ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)) and ships to the App Store about every two weeks ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). I also noticed the open issue on the SDK 52 upgrade being blocked by a native module mismatch ([github.com](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)). Is that mismatch something you are working around in your EAS build profiles, or is it holding your whole update pipeline on SDK 51?
